title: Culture, expansion, and flow-cytometry-based functional analysis of pteropid bat MR1-restricted unconventional T cells
protocol: Thaw a few vials from multiple bats as a backup.
Thaw cryovials in a water bath set at 37°C until a small piece of ice remains.
Transport cryovials into a biosafety cabinet class-II on wet ice.
Practice aseptic technique.
Work in a BSC-II from this step onwards.
Transfer cells into a sterile 50 mL falcon tube in the BSC-II.
Add cold R10 medium dropwise onto cells.
Swirl tube to mix as media is being added.
Mix well.
Centrifuge tube at 390 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant into diluted (10%) bleach.
Resuspend cells with 10 mL of cold PBS.
Centrifuge tube at 390 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Repeat step twice for a total of 3× PBS washes.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL cold R10 medium.
Allow cells to recover at 23°C–25°C for 30 min.
Perform cell count by Trypan Blue exclusion.
Keep reagents on ice and centrifuge cold at 4°C during the recovery step.
Wash out DMSO thoroughly to minimize DMSO toxicity on bat immune cells.
Add 10 mL PBS to cells, mix well.
Centrifuge tube at 390 x g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant by inverting the tube and pipette out any excess residual liquid.
Resuspend cells in complete expansion media (IC expansion medium diluted with base IC culture medium at a 1:1 ratio) at 5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Add 5-OP-RU to final concentration of 10 nM (x1000 dilution).
Mix well and plate cells onto sterile 96-well U-bottom plate at 200 μL per well (10^6 cells/well).
Incubate cells at 37°C in the 5% CO2 incubator.
Replace half volume of media with IC expansion medium (2× cytokines) every 2 days by pipetting out half volume and adding back equivalent volume.
Mix well during media change.
If cells are disturbed, centrifuge supernatant and resuspend pellet with fresh media before returning to wells.
Add 5-OP-RU at final concentration of 10 nM on day 5 and 10.
Recover viable cells with Ficoll density gradient centrifugation on day 11.
Stain cells for flow-cytometry-based analysis on day 0, 10, and 14 post-culture.
Transfer 10^6 cells into a 96-well V-bottom plate.
Wash once with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Spin at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Add 50 μL of 10% FCS or bat serum diluted in FACS buffer to block cells.
Incubate blocking solution with cells for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Pre-block cells with hMR1-6-FP fluorescent-conjugated tetramer diluted in FACS buffer for 40 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Spin at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Stain cells with 50 μL diluted fluorochrome conjugated hMR1-5-OP-RU and hMR1-6-FP tetramer.
Incubate staining solution with cells for 40 minutes at 23°C–25°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Spin at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Stain cells with 50 μL surface staining cocktail and viability dye for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Spin cells at 390 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Fix cells with 100 μL 1× BD TF Fix buffer for 40 min at 4°C in the dark.
Change centrifuge speed to 757 × g.
Add 100 μL 1× BD TF Perm Wash.
Spin cells at 757 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Add 200 μL 1× BD TF perm wash to remove the remaining fixative buffer.
Spin cells at 757 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove residual liquid by pipetting.
Stain cells with 50 μL intracellular staining cocktail containing anti-CD3ε and anti-Perforin in 1× BD TF perm wash for 40 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 150 μL 1× BD TF perm wash.
Spin cells at 757 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Transfer cells to FACS tubes.
Store tubes in the dark at 4°C until acquisition.
Acquire cells on a flow cytometer.
Export files as Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS) 3.0.
Analyze files using flow-cytometry-based analysis software such as FlowJo.
Seed cells at 5 × 10^4 cells per well in 200 μL cell culture media into a 96-well flat bottom plate 18 hours before the assay.
Harvest cells from three representative wells and count cells on the day of the experiment.
Remove medium from the harvested cells.
Add back 90 μL fresh pre-warm R10 medium to the harvested cells.
Thaw stock tube with bacteria on ice.
Add 5 × 10^8 bacteria into 1 mL PBS in a 1.5 mL tube.
Spin at 5000 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend bacteria in 500 μL of 1% formaldehyde.
Vortex at maximum speed for the first 60 seconds and again during the final 30 seconds.
Add 500 μL PBS to wash bacteria, then spin at 5000 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL PBS to wash.
Spin at 5000 × g for 3 minutes at 4°C and discard the supernatant.
Repeat PBS wash step.
Resuspend bacteria in 1 mL cold (2°C–8°C) R10 medium.
Adjust bacteria stock for a bacterial dose of 30 CFU per target cell in 10 μL R10 media with appropriate number of samples.
Add 10 μL of adjusted bacteria stock to target cells.
Spin at 58× g for 2 min with minimal brake at 23°C–25°C.
Incubate at 37°C in the 5% CO2 incubator for 3 h.
Prepare and add 2 nM 5-OP-RU or 25 μM Ac-6-FP to corresponding wells after 1 h of incubation with bacteria, then incubate for 2 h.
Determine purity of effector (expanded MR1T) cells one day before assay by flow-cytometry-based analysis.
Collect expanded day 15–18 MR1T cells into a sterile 50 mL falcon tube.
Spin at 390 × g, 5 min at 23°C–25°C.
Decant supernatant.
Add 10 ml PBS to wash and perform cell count by Trypan Blue exclusion.
Spin at 390 × g, 5 min at 23°C–25°C.
Discard supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend cells at 5 ×10^6 cells/mL with PBS.
Dilute CellTrace™ Violet (CTV) stocks 1:50 with PBS, in the dark.
Work in a darkened BSC-II when using CTV.
Add diluted CTV to cells at a 1:100 dilution (final 1:5000).
Mix well by gentle vortexing to achieve uniform labeling of effector cells.
Wrap the tube with aluminum foil.
Incubate tube at 37°C for 30 min in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Add 20 mL of pre-warmed R10 medium to quench reaction.
Incubate for a further 15 min at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Spin cells at 390 × g, 5 min at 23°C–25°C to wash.
Wash cells twice with 15 mL pre-warmed (37°C) PBS.
Spin cells at 390 × g, 5 min at 23°C–25°C.
Resuspend cells in R10 medium at a determined cell concentration for adjusted E:T ratio, purity, and number of samples per 100 μL.
Adjust effector cells to final volume of 100 μL with an effector to target cell (E:T) ratio of 10:1.
Add 100 μL of effector cells to target.
Work in a darkened BSC-II.
Mix gently and spin at 58 × g for 2 min with minimal brake at 23°C–25°C to allow cell-to-cell contact.
Incubate for 24 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
After 24 h, mix wells of the assay-plate and transfer to a 96-well V-bottom plate to collect floating cells.
Spin 96-well V-bottom plate at 390 × g, 5 min at 23°C–25°C.
Discard supernatant by pipetting.
Resuspend wells of the assay plate with 200 μL PBS.
Transfer the PBS wash to a 96-well V-bottom plate to collect remaining floating cells.
Spin the V-bottom plate at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 23°C–25°C.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Add 30 μL of Trypsin-EDTA to wells of the assay plate and treat cells for 5 minutes at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Add 100 μL of R10 to wells to stop the reaction.
Mix and transfer cells from the assay plate to the same V-bottom plate.
Spin the V-bottom plate at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 23°C–25°C.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Wash cells on the V-bottom plate with 200 μL cold (2°C-8°C) FACS buffer.
Spin the V-bottom plate at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 23°C–25°C.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Proceed to staining for flow-cytometry-based analysis.
Supply freshly-thawed autologous bat immune cells as antigen-presenting cells (APCs) for the assay.
Verify cytokine production using available reagents: tumor necrosis factor (TNF) and IL-17.
Thaw cells as described above and determine cell number.
Seed cells at 5 × 10^4 cells per well in 90 μL into a sterile 96-well U-bottom plate in R10 medium.
Add PBS to empty wells to minimize evaporation.
Adjust fixed bacteria stock for a bacterial dose of 3 CFU per 0.05 × 10^6 autologous target cell in 10 μL and with number of reactions.
Incubate for 3 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Prepare and add 2 nM 5-OP-RU or 25 μM Ac-6-FP and incubate for 2 h at 37°C in 5% CO2 incubator.
Determine the purity of expanded MR1T cells one day before assay by flow-cytometry-based analysis.
Resuspend CTV-labeled effector cells in R10 medium at a concentration of 2.5 × 10^5 per 100 μL.
Add 100 μL of effector (Pa MR1T cells) to target cells (autologous APCs) with an E:T ratio of 5:1.
Mix gently at the surface.
Incubate for at least 2 hours at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
During the last 6 hours of the assay, add BD Leukocyte Activation Cocktail and BD GolgiPlug™ to PMA control wells.
Add BD GolgiStop™ Protein Transport Inhibitor to all wells.
Mix and transfer cells to a 96-well V-bottom plate at the experimental endpoint.
Spin the V-bottom plate at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 23°C–25°C.
Discard supernatant.
Wash assay plate once with 200 μL of PBS.
Transfer the PBS wash to the same V-bottom plate.
Spin V-bottom plate at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 23°C–25°C.
Discard supernatant.
Proceed to staining for flow-cytometry-based analysis.
Dilute anti-CD3ε, anti-TNF, and anti-IL17 in 1× BD TF perm wash.
Stain expanded culture 1 day before the assay to determine purity of effector cells.
Guidance on adjusting E:T ratio based on purity determination (Dias et al., 2016).
Flow-cytometry-based acquisition of stained cells should be done immediately if possible.
Store samples protected from light at 4°C for up to 24 hours if immediate analysis is not feasible.
Thaw and count cells as above.
Resuspend cells in 5 × 10^6 cells/mL of PBS.
Collect and store 10^4 cells at 4°C for non-CTV control.
Prepare a diluted stock of CTV in 1:40 with PBS.
Add diluted CTV to cells at 1:100 (final concentration 1:4000).
Mix well with gentle vortexing.
Wrap tube with foil.
Resuspend CTV-labeled cells at 10^6 cells per 190 μL with expansion media.
Take an aliquot of 10^6 CTV-labeled cells for day 0 baseline staining.
Take an aliquot of 10^4 CTV-labeled cells as a CTV compensation control.
Store cells in dark at 4°C until staining step.
Plate cells into sterile 96-well U-bottom plate at 190 μL per well.
Resuspend formaldehyde-fixed E. coli in 1 mL IC culture media.
Adjust and prepare MR1 ligands to 10 nM for 5-OP-RU or 25 μM for Ac-6-FP, or adjust bacterial dose of fixed E. coli to 0.1 CFU/cell diluted in IC expansion media.
Add prepared MR1 ligands in 10 μL to plated cells for a final culture volume of 200 μL per well.
Add 200 μL PBS to remaining empty wells to reduce evaporation of culture media.
Culture plate at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Replace half of the media every 2 days with IC expansion media containing 2× IL-2 and IL-7 cytokines.
Perform cell count and stain cells on day 3, 5, 7, and 10 to determine expansion based on cell numbers CTV dilution.
Transfer collected 10^6 CTV-labeled cells into a 96-well V-bottom plate.
Take 50 μL of culture from well for staining.
Work in a darkened BSC-II.
Wash cells once with 200 μL FACS buffer.
Spin the cells at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Add 50 μL of a 10% solution of either FCS or bat serum diluted in FACS buffer to block cells for 30 minutes at 4°C.
Wash cells with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Spin the cells at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Stain cells with 50 μL of diluted fluorochrome-conjugated hMR1-5-OP-RU and hMR1-6-FP tetramer for 40 minutes at 23°C–25°C in darkness.
Wash cells with 150 μL FACS buffer.
Spin the cells at 390 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Stain cells with 50 μL of surface staining cocktail containing a viability dye for 30 minutes at 4°C in darkness.
Transfer previously prepared aliquots of CTV-labeled cells to empty wells on the V-bottom plate for compensation control.
Fix cells with 100 μL of 1× BD TF Fix buffer for 40 minutes at 4°C in darkness.
Add 100 μL of 1× BD TF Perm Wash solution and spin the cells at 757 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Wash with 200 μL of 1× BD TF perm wash to remove remaining fixative.
Spin the cells at 757 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Pipette out remaining excess residual liquid.

Stain cells with 50 μL intracellular staining cocktail containing anti-CD3ε and optional antibodies (anti-T-bet, anti-Eomes, anti-PLZF, and anti-RORγt) in 1× BD TF perm wash for 40 min at 4°C in the dark.
Wash cells with 150 μL 1× BD TF perm wash.
Spin cells at 757× g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL FACS buffer.
Transfer resuspended cells to FACS tubes.
Store tubes in the dark at 4°C until acquisition.
Acquire stained cells on a flow cytometer.
Add 5-OP-RU into culture media immediately before intended experiments (within 2 min).
Work in a darkened BSC-II when handling reagents sensitive to light.
Triturate 5-OP-RU, Ac-6-FP, and bacterial dose to determine optimal concentrations for experimental setup.
Minimize light exposure when working with CTV-labelled cells.
Set aside unlabeled and CTV-labeled cells cultured in IC culture media throughout the experiment for compensation matrix and FMO control on assay day.
